attrs.tool_parameters:
{"bash_command":"gh","full_command":"gh pr create --base main --title "fix(test): cmd/wipnote suite hits 10m timeout (bug-26a976ab)" --body "Root cause: seedPassingGateRecord set a fresh empty GOCACHE per test, so the nested \`go vet ./...\` in runSessionGate recompiled the stdlib in every provenance-gate test (minutes each under load). Not a deadlock; the goroutine dump showed the test blocked in os/exec wait on that nested go vet.

Fix: stop overriding GOCACHE in provenance_gate_test.go (TestMain already exports one shared warm cache, as check_gate_test.go does). Also buildOtelCollectTestBinary built into t.TempDir(), deleted after the first caller, so every recap/otel test relinked the binary; it now uses os.MkdirTemp (TestMain cleans up) with a mutex, and buildRecapBinary reuses it.

Timings (machine load avg ~18): TestProvenanceGate_* 2 min+ each -> ~3s each (package run 15s). Full ./cmd/wipnote/: timed out at 10m -> ok in 522s.

attrs.tool_parameters:
{"bash_command":"git","full_command":"git commit -q -m "fix(telemetry): finalize session NDJSON at SessionEnd and catch up orphans (bug-bb96a980)

With serve and its indexer gone, nothing ingested events.ndjson into
otel_signals, so the SessionEnd rollup missed api_request cost and token
data, and SessionEnd marked the log consumed before anything read it.
Sessions without a clean SessionEnd were never marked, so retention never
archived them.

- New observe/otel/finalize: Session replays one session's NDJSON from
  byte 0 into a private projection (indexer.ReplaySession, the reindex
  path), materializes the rollup, then publishes .index-offset for the
  bytes it read. A spent budget writes nothing.
- SessionEnd calls it through SessionTelemetryFn with a bounded budget
  (900ms under Codex's 3s cap, 10s elsewhere).
- finalize.CatchUp finishes stale unmarked sessions before every
  retention sweep (SessionStart, writer daemon, wipnote prune) and in
  wipnote session prune/archive.
- exit-plan-mode points at plan validate-yaml and plan slices, not the
  removed plan review.
- The daemon-unreachable message names the launcher, not wipnote serve.
- read-feedback counts comment-only sections as undecided and reports a
  finalized/completed/done plan's real meta.status.
- Fix the ledger control test the PR rewrote: the graph reader returns
  the pruned tombstone row, so assert it has no renderable title.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>" && git log --oneline -1","description":"Commit the fix"}
